description:
The Journey starts with the new Reveal frame design that takes advantage of the wider, taller EVO 386 bottom brackets that allows the use of the industry’s only seamless super oversized butted titanium tubing. This maintains the lateral stiffness and magic carpet ride our titanium bikes are known for while cutting over a pound of frame weight. Riders choose titanium for its scratch resistant finish and durability when they plan to travel and tour. Adding to its touring chops, the new design uses the most common sizes for bottom brackets, seatposts, stems and head-sets for easy maintenance when you’re away from home. The reconfigured Journey now incorporates the Evolve carbon disc fork and Gen4 10” rotor for superior stopping power in all-weather conditions.

Also available with our Z-Couplers for easy travel with the Safecase system. Starting at $11,995 with the Reveal standard build kit and Ultegra 2×11 drivetrain in your choice of gearing.
